items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: Happy Caldwell mentions Prince Robinson as one of the three tenor players 'you had to get by' alongside Coleman Hawkins, but does not describe a direct personal or professional interaction between himself and Robinson.
